blocks.content: This project focuses on the skills that power most interactive websites and games.

items: Build and update the game board using the DOM.
Control the game flow with scoring, timers, and random mole spawns.
Respond to player actions using click events.
Debug issues as they come up and keep your code readable as the project grows.

blocks.content: These are the same building blocks you will reuse in many real web projects.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
